crossRefs.note: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until…
crossRefs.keyword: bring upon thee. Heb. cause to ascend

translations.web: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until you are destroyed.
translations.bsb: The LORD will also bring upon you every sickness and plague not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.
translations.kjv: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
translations.asv: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will Jehovah bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
